response.justification: Bogdan brings well over a decade of full-stack experience with a strong core-stack match: TypeScript/Node.js in production at Optilyz, RIDE Capital and currently re:cinq, plus React, MongoDB, AWS CDK, Docker/Kubernetes and Git. He also has directly relevant AI-agent experience (MCP code generators and agentic tooling), which is an explicit requirement and rare among candidates. Testing depth is exceptional — he authored a test runner and assertion library, and taught TDD/Selenium courses — which maps well to the Vitest/Jest/Playwright expectation even though those exact tools aren't named. Gaps are Nest.js, Kotlin, and limited recent frontend depth (much of his UI history is Ember rather than React), but these are learnable for an engineer of this caliber. A BS in Computer Science and demonstrated communication skills through public talks and workshops round out the profile.
strengths: 15+ years full-stack; deep TypeScript/Node.js production experience
Hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work matching a key requirement
Exceptional testing/TDD credibility (built test runner and assertion libraries)
concerns: No Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin experience listed
Frontend depth skews Ember/legacy; React exposure appears limited
Significant investment in niche DLang may signal stack-preference friction
